caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, upright chest or trunk with a dark brown, wood-textured surface and reinforced brass or brass-colored metal edges and corners. The trunk features numerous circular rivets along the metal bands for structural reinforcement. The lid is flat with slightly rounded corners, and it has a brown leather or leather-like handle centered on top, fastened down with two metal brackets. The front of the trunk has a prominent ornate gold-colored lock plate with a circular keyhole, central latch, and two symmetrical latches or clasps on either side for securing the lid. The entire object is rendered in realistic detail, with carefully shaded brown, gold, and metallic hues, and is set against a plain, light-colored background.
title: Small Square Trunk
